critical_code_review_comments: DataRiver.jsx digit color #3E6B47 is very dark forest-green; on dark #0B0B14 river body the digits appear near-black to the eye though technically green. If more visibility desired, consider lightening to ~#5A9165, but spec asked for 'muted DARK green' so current implementation matches spec.
OrbitRings.jsx computes container = diameter + 2*(L+pad) = 588 which can overflow at 1440px viewport with sibling text column; verify no clip on smaller desktops (>=1024 but <1280).
